title: INVENT survey: Culture and cultural participation in Europe: Meanings, perceptions, practices and societal values
contributors: Alysa Karels (Netherlands); Guiseppe Lamberti, Jinju Kim, Joan Llonch-Andreu, Pilar Lopez (Spain); Neta Yodovich, Geffen Ben-David (UK); Franziska Marquart, Unni From (Denmark); Ossi Sirkka, Sara Sivonen, Riie Heikkilä (Finland); Simon Walo (Switzerland); Željka Zdravković, Augustin Derado (Croatia); Danijela Gavrilović, Milos Jovanović, Nemanja Krstić, Anna Fotev, Visjna Kisić, Goran Tomka (Serbia); Lucas Page Pereira, Philipe Bonnet, Johs Hjellbrekke, Brigitte Le Roux (France)
descriptions: This 2021 survey of 14,384 adults examined cultural values, practices, and perceptions among national representative samples in nine European countries. The survey yielded robust, comparative data on how how social, economic, and cultural contexts shape access to and engagement with culture. Specialised survey agencies were responsible for administering the survey using a combination of methods (CATI, PAPI, CAWI and F2F). Data was collected by the INVENT consortium, funded by the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme (grant No. 870691).
